0022600174.text: The Atlanta Hawks (3-4, 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back and 7th in the East) head into this road game on a one-game losing streak, while the Washington Wizards (3-3, 1st in the Southeast and 6th in the East) have won their last game. Out for Atlanta are Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture) and Kingston Flemings (suspension), and out for Washington are Alex Sarr (knee soreness), Anthony Gill (back spasms), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, while the Hawks won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 126-96 win in Atlanta on February 26, 2026.
